description: package binaries (§19): `packages/app` and `packages/web` generate src/generated/client.js with the internal bin `gen-client` of the workspace package `tools/gen` (`gen-client < schema.json > …` and `pnpm exec gen-client < schema.json > …`; resolved through the bin field, no `.bin` link). The bin requires lib/render.js and reads templates/header.txt next to it. Generated files are gitignored; the oracle never runs generators, so the tests affected through them are declared with expect_affected.

mutations.name: bin-lib
mutations.description: edit a module the bin requires

mutations.name: bin-template
mutations.description: edit the template the bin reads with fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, …))

mutations.name: schema
mutations.description: edit the schema file redirected into the bin

mutations.name: bin-unused-module
mutations.description: control: edit a module of the bin package that the bin does not require

mutations.name: bin-unused-template
mutations.description: control: edit a file next to the template that the bin does not read

mutations.name: bin-readme
mutations.description: control: edit the bin package's README
